column7: 2026-11-05: User rule: nothing on this branch (vendor/deploy-tools) may emit any warning, ever (deploy-tools CI runs pytest with -W error; a vendored DeprecationWarning broke their release in March). If something is renamed/retired, the old spelling must keep working silently.

2026-11-05: My choices (not user rules): leading v/V stripping is done via argparse type=_version_arg in src/semver/cli.py, so cmd_* called directly still get raw strings. New tests import semver.cli.main because semver.main warns. Open item: ~157 existing tests fail under -W error since they call deprecated top-level functions (semver.replace, semver.main); left untouched, ask user whether to fix. Changelog file pr505.feature.rst uses a guessed PR number.

2026-11-05: My choices: dict deprecation in Version.compare uses warnings.warn (not the deprecated decorator: it wraps whole functions and _deprecated imports version, so circular). Comparison operators with dicts convert before compare, so they don't warn (not asked). Changelog fragment pr506.deprecation.rst: PR number is a guess.

2026-11-05: Renamed Version.next_version kwarg prerelease_token -> token (positional 2nd arg); prerelease_token kept as silent keyword-only alias (no DeprecationWarning, per no-warnings rule). Changelog pr507.trivial.rst uses a guessed PR number (mine).
